questions.question: The Panchayat (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act of 1996 is also known as which Act of the Indian Parliament?

The Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Amendment Act

questions.explanation: Proportional reasoning.

questions.explanation: Rohan's mother's sister is his mother, so Rohan's mother is his Aunt.

questions.explanation: The person's father-in-law is the husband of the person's mother-in-law, making the person's father-in-law the person's father.
